decisions.capital: Exact previous calendar reported stock, interpreted as December stock by explicit assumption; preserve documentary flag separately.
decisions.investment: Positive reported additions, separately assumed candidate, never stock difference; preserve documentary flag separately.
decisions.estimation: Constant sector-pooled slopes and existing control functions; no new year fixed effects.
decisions.normalization: Subtract mean uncentered residual across every dynamic fitted observation of sector/method/sample/variant, fixed across years.
decisions.bootstrap: Existing99 whole-fictional-company-history draws; exact lag rules rebuilt per draw; existing method code unchanged.
decisions.attachment: All primary domain predictions plus separate in_fit flags; original source columns/rows preserved.
